items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: The rhythm was Shelly Manne, Bob Carter on bass and Lou Levy on piano. Bill Harris, me and Milty Gold. So we played for three weeks there.

ctx.x: It was ’49. And we went to Chicago for three weeks. We had three trombones and rhythm. The rhythm was Shelly Manne, Bob Carter on bass and Lou Levy on piano. Bill Harris, me and Milty Gold. So we played for three weeks there. And then Mildred Bailey was supposed to join us and she was sick or something so there was a gap of like three or four weeks. And we were booked in Birdland. But everybody says man, what are we going to do for three or four weeks, just hang out? So everybody went with different bands.
It definitely was a — you had to grab the opportunities when they came, didn’t you?
